Description of the features
 
Remote control copying:
 
Via a step-by-step guide that includes text and images, users can copy various original rolling code or fixed code remote controls. Automatic, manual and clone copying options are available for rolling codes, as well as a scanner option for certain models.
 
Remote control reading
 
At any time, users can read the information stored on each button of a ERREBI remote control and save it in a database for subsequent use if necessary.
 
Remote control generation
 
By using this app, rolling code remote controls can be generated without needing the original remote. This process can be completed by selecting the manufacturer and configuring the desired settings or by loading up a remote control previously saved in the database.
 
Fixed codes can only be loaded from a database if they have been stored previously, but without selecting the manufacturer or model.
